## 维护者速读

Three ADR pointers into `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` resolve by coincidence of spelling. Each lands on a local variable or a string literal inside a function body, while its sentence describes a different mechanism. The PR changes the three anchors and nothing else: no prose, and no `anchor-exempt` marker. Each new target is a method declaration the class keeps across every cut of the split.

## The reading (ruling `6353073966`, at `5801a4f2c`)

| anchor | resolves on today | what the sentence describes | candidate target |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| ADR-0055:26 `security-plugin.ts#sharingModel` | `declaration`, one site: the local `const sharingModel = …` inside `computeControlledByParentFilter` (`:9208`) | the #1994 by-id write pre-image check, "the exact hook to extend with a master-access check" | `#checkControlledByParentWrite` (`:9492`), or a file-level anchor if the author reads the #1994 step (inline in `start()`, step 2.7) as naming no symbol |
| ADR-0055:58 `security-plugin.ts#controlled_by_parent` | `literal`, three sites inside the read derivation (`:9035`, `:9209`, `:9275`) | the §3 write pre-image block | `#checkControlledByParentWrite` |
| ADR-0123:4 `security-plugin.ts#refuseNoActiveOrganization` | `declaration`: the local closure `const refuseNoActiveOrganization = (…)` inside `composeWriteTenantWall` (`:8499`) | D2's refusal, step 3.7 | `#composeWriteTenantWall` (`:8432`) |

The write half the two ADR-0055 sentences name (`checkControlledByParentWrite` through `assertMasterRowEditable`) holds no `'controlled_by_parent'` token and binds no `sharingModel`. The gate's header says why the gate cannot see this: it checks that an anchor "POINTS AT SOMETHING REAL", not that the sentence is true. The targets above are candidates. The PR author proposes them and the maintainer approves or amends.

## Acceptance

- The PR's diff is the three anchor spellings in `docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md` and `docs/adr/0123-no-active-organization-session-semantics.md`. Nothing else changes.
- `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` exits 0 on the head, with each of the three new anchors resolving as `declaration` class.
- ⛔ No prose edit (the gate header: "Do not repair prose to clear this gate"). ⛔ No `anchor-exempt` marker (maintainer-only).
- Lands only on the maintainer's APPROVED review. If the maintainer declines, the bodies stay in `security-plugin.ts` for the series' end state (ruling item 4), and #25223's final report says so.
